title: Article editorial analysis
description: Prompt 1 of evidence-aware article drafting: an editorial analyst assesses a YAML Question branch for gaps and scores its article readiness.

variables.name: audience
variables.description: `author` (default) evaluates their own branch; `subscriber` evaluates another user's public reasoning to find where they can contribute.

surfaces: My Vision → Options → Analyze reasoning (`analyze_reasoning`: a Question with a Question → Idea → Claim chain)
Shared Vision → Article mode (author and subscriber)

usage.notes: symthink-io caps the assembled prompt at 40,000 characters and the branch at 15 levels before rendering.
